asset: WaterDuel mannequin v4 — construction, unique UV and physical integration

axes.origin: ground midpoint in the authored model; spread fencing stance

pose.source: Normal/amber retain v2 rest skeleton and fencing pose. Boss retains normalized v2 rig and scaled rest skeleton.
pose.glb: Authored fencing pose exported as joint rest pose; inverse-bind matrices differ from v1.

weighting: Rigid 1.0 weight per vertex to one bone; 18 joints, no organic blending
equipment: Hide three Preview_Rapier_* GLB nodes; source objects Rapier_* and Leather_Grip_Wrap_*; attach Items equipment at Socket_MainHand/SecondaryHand.

textures.note: Visible character resources pruned/remapped before GPU upload; optional rapier images remain embedded for authoring previews. RGBA8+mips estimates exclude driver overhead.

bounds_glb.space: glTF world, initial node and skin transforms; animations not evaluated
glTF world, initial node and skin transforms; animations not evaluated
glTF world, initial node and skin transforms; animations not evaluated

limits.physics: Planar multibody with depth layers and reduced lateral neck; 16 DOF, not a full 3D Coulomb solver.
limits.cloth: 12-node reduced cloth. Body drives accessory; accessory cannot prop up or displace body. Dynamic textured vertex positions share the contact surface.
limits.optical: Imported head/water/crest are static presentation geometry; game generates its own membrane/water. Protected serialized materials equal v3.
limits.sweep: CPU geometry/ground sweep from motor inputs; no triangle-triangle clearance proof, no GPU or FPS claim
limits.performance: No FPS or phone-hardware benchmark is inferred from CPU tests or Blender previews.
limits.publication: Principal owns versions, packaging and publication; this script never publishes.

references.w1: Fencing guard, separated feet, bent lead knee, extended rapier
references.w2: Honey wood PBR, satin brass bearings, wrapped grip/wooden fingers, folded knot and sloped waterline
references.w3: Flexible latex ribbons and connected perforated water sheets with curved ligaments/drops
references.w4: Separate boss silhouette, armor, dark heraldic breastplate and burgundy tabard

geometry_baseline: v3 authored rig/pivots preserved; geometry and UV revised

solver.footFrame: pose.feet.front/back.matrix, world units, origin at achieved ankle
solver.legacy: Snapshots without feet use the historical horizontal foot mapper; snapshots without cloth use the legacy apron hinge.
